en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing four kittens interacting with ornate floral china on a table. One kitten stands on its hind legs drinking from a tall jug, another drinks from a teacup and saucer, a third with a red ribbon around its neck is lapping from a shallow saucer, and the fourth with a blue ribbon has its paw in a two-handled sugar bowl. The background is a light cream color. Handwritten text appears at the top left and along the bottom margin.
